canonical_project: TTC Funafuti server room / network core (provisional Vaka production environment)
notes: JICA 2026 survey (A) describes TTC's single-story building in Funafuti/Vaiaku containing a server room; Vaka cable runs provisionally from this facility (from 2025-10) before the planned micro data center is delivered. Asset class: telco-server-room / network-core. This is a telecom core/server room, not a commercial colocation datacenter (no customer-facing colo/racks marketed). TTC official site (tuvalutelecom.tv) confirms operator identity, Vaiaku/Funafuti address and fixed/mobile/internet services.
